name: B2B pricing settings
description: Explains where B2B groups, percents and per-variant prices are edited
title: B2B pricing is configured in custom data, not here
body: Groups: Settings → Custom data → Shop → "B2B groups" — JSON of group → percent off everything, e.g. {"contractor": 25, "wholesale": 35}. Customers: open a customer and set "B2B group" (a key from that JSON) and/or "B2B discount %" (this customer's own percent, beats the group's). Empty = retail prices.
hint: Per-variant prices: open a product → variant → "B2B prices" — JSON per group key or per customer ID (the number in the customer's admin URL): a fixed price (number) or a percent off ("30%"), e.g. {"contractor": 12.5, "wholesale": "30%", "9588593000471": 11}. These beat the customer/group percent.
